summary: First test iteration for Sihha AI rebuild. Comprehensive backend (28 pytest cases) and frontend (Playwright) tests. All backend endpoints working: auth (Bearer + cookie), vitals with out-of-range alert generation, alerts read, medications CRUD + adherence + missed-dose alert, dependents (with scoped vitals), doctor role toggle + doctor portal listing/summary, chat SSE streaming with GPT-5.5 (real LLM), report generation (real LLM), pill identification with vision (real LLM). Frontend flows validated: landing, dashboard, log vitals, sync wearable, alerts bell, medications add + mark taken, dependents add (select relation), role toggle to doctor showing nav-doctor, chat streaming (typing dots + bubble creation observed).

issues: Hero H1 text 'Your health, understood in real time.' renders with low contrast (light grey on cream). May be a fade-up animation state captured mid-transition, but final state also appears faint vs body text — worth checking css text-ink color intensity.

action_items: Optional: verify hero H1 contrast on Landing after fade-up animation completes
Optional: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (non-blocking)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py chat cleanup fixture in tests deletes all chat_messages globally — fine for isolated test DB but not for shared envs; consider scoping cleanup by session_id in future.
identify_pill: split on '```' assumes at least one fence; safe fallback exists via try/except json.loads, good.
check_vital_alerts severity threshold uses lo*0.85 and hi*1.15 which for spo2 hi=100 means 115, so spo2 never triggers critical — acceptable but noted.
chat SSE endpoint returns 200 with error payload inside stream on LLM failure (good), but the error is only yielded if raised before StreamDone; adequate.
test_credentials: MongoDB-inserted session tokens (see /app/auth_testing.md). Test session used for UI: user_id=test-ui-1784235150842, token=test_ui_session_1784235150842. Backend tests self-provision users via pytest fixtures.
seed_data_creation: Test users + sessions inserted into sihha_ai.users and sihha_ai.user_sessions. Fixtures clean up after run; the UI-testing user remains for main agent's own retest convenience.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend + frontend passing. To re-run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v (takes ~70s due to real LLM calls). For UI, insert a mongo session and add cookie session_token to domain ab05f5cb-...preview.emergentagent.com. Chat streaming can take 20-40s per turn; UI shows typing dots while streaming. All required data-testid attributes are present including add-medication-btn, med-input-name/dosage/times, med-submit-btn, dose-taken-btn-*, add-dependent-btn, dependent-input-name, dependent-input-relation (SELECT element, use select_option), dependent-submit-btn, toggle-role-btn, nav-doctor, chat-input, chat-send-btn.
